testSetup: Two independent Windows Host and Client processes in a private Photon room.
Each peer attacked using all eleven real ItemData/prefab variants (including two vacuum variants and existing knife/scissors).
Fixture spawned/equipped actual items through ItemBase.TryEquip and the networked equipped-item property; physical pickup was not simulated.
Positions and starting health/stamina were prepared on StateAuthority; regeneration was disabled only in temporary test harness.
Attacks invoked the existing InputAuthority RPC used by left click; physical mouse clicks were not simulated.
Weapon-enabled mission vacuum used the existing right-click RPC against real FilterDust and completed suction.
Other mission items retained their use handlers; full oxygen insertion, lever mounting and assembly completion were not played through.
Existing Laver_Shader_Graph shader parse error remains; Windows test build succeeded.
Original .meta GUIDs, prefab references, C# scripts and previous look work were preserved.
